title: Ben Rich says the math in Maxwell's equations is a little off
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ben Rich says the math in Maxwell's equations is a little off, about 1990s at Lockheed Skunk Works, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: even going back to the '9s, Ben Rich saying there was some math in Maxwell's equations that was a little off.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that back in the 1990s Ben Rich, who ran Lockheed's Skunk Works, the company's secret aircraft design unit, said some of the math in Maxwell's equations was a little off. Maxwell's equations are the basic rules of electricity and magnetism, so Michels tells it as a hint that insiders knew of physics beyond what is taught.
